description: Update an existing BrewPage HTML/Markdown page. Requires owner token. Returns the updated page metadata. The link and delivery mode never change on update; an advisory deliveryModeReason and delivery notice are included when the new content uses browser features that may not work fully on a BrewPage link. Old publications (made before 5 October 2026) are read-only: 409 OLD_PUBLICATION_READ_ONLY with createUrl to publish anew.

format.description: Content format. Accepts (case-insensitive on html/markdown): 'html', 'markdown'/'md', or a code language — yaml, json, xml, csv, tsv, log, toml, ini, sql, sh, bat, env, javascript, typescript, tsx, jsx, css, properties, docker, txt. Omit to preserve the stored format.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN.

name: update_html
title: Update page
